lines.text: He seems like a pretty cool kid.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: I like him. (pause) You go over there quite a bit on the weekends huh? Seems like a nice place to be. So how'd the night go in the motel room.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: It's a pretty nice place there, Fox Hills, isn't it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Yeah. (pause) The sky, it looks like it could snow a little bit today.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: I'm more worried about the a freezin' rain that's supposed to come in later. They're sayin' it's supposed to go up to 40 something today.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When we get into Mishicot, we'll turn right.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Drink, anything, bag a chips or something cuz this may you know be a little while.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you ever go there to eat?
